supersedes_role_only.change: The Nara/Kawasaki pair remains a fixed PRE-only coverage/time-stability diagnostic, but is not sufficient as the sole primary development evaluation population.

selection_rule.include: Every Japanese keirin meeting whose official/local Day1 race date is 2026-09-24 and whose PRE racecard can be positively captured under the existing source/provenance rules.
selection_rule.race_membership: All positively captured official Day1 races in every included meeting; transport/source failures are retained fail-closed rather than silently dropped.
selection_rule.venue_set_freeze_rule: Derive the complete venue set mechanically from the national schedule for meetings starting 2026-09-24, then freeze exact Day1 cards PRE-only as they become available. Do not add/remove a venue based on candidate overlap.

rationale: Sep24 was already named in the 2026-09-03 pre-result identifiability design as a later time-stability/support period.
Sep24 is strictly later than the current Sep14/Sep15 fit-candidate period and remains before the separately reserved Sep27/Sep29 final untouched pair.
Using the whole Day1-start date avoids a narrow two-venue population and prevents rider-mix-driven venue selection.

scoring_rule.primary_population: All eligible races in the frozen Sep24 Day1-start population, including explicit S0_FALLBACK rows for unsupported riders.
scoring_rule.supported_rider_active_term_subset: Report separately as a diagnostic only; it cannot rescue a failed all-race primary metric.
scoring_rule.fallback_fraction: Must be reported overall and by circumference.
scoring_rule.zero_active_term_coverage: If no challenger-active rows remain after PRE gates, development advancement is impossible and the rider-specific family is NO_ADVANCE for practical use; do not tune around it.

source_discovery.final_assignment_authority: Positive PRE racecards / exact official identity chain under existing research rules
